# Body pile

Internal ID: Spawner_DraugrPile | Usage: Draugr (melee) (43% chance), Draugr (ranged) (43% chance), Draugr elite (14% chance) | Weak to (x1.5): Spirit | Neutral to (x1): Blunt, ,, Slash, ,, Lightning, ,, Frost | Resistant to (x0.5): Pierce, ,, Fire | Immune to (x0): Chop, ,, Pickaxe, ,, Poison

# Introduction

The Body pile is a creature spawner found in Sunken Crypts, Draugr Villages, Swamp and Mountain.
The pile can spawn any draugr:
• Draugr (melee) (43% chance)
• Draugr (ranged) (43% chance)
• Draugr elite (14% chance)
Spawned enemies have a 15% chance to be 1-star and a 2.25% chance to be 2-star.
The nest activates when there is a player within 20 meters. The nest attempts to spawn within 3 meters every 6 seconds until there are 2 draugr within 20 meters.

## Notes

• In Sunken Crypts they may not spawn anything if there are draugr in nearby rooms.
• Body piles are the best way to farm Draugr Elite trophy.
• It is recommended to dispose of them as soon as possible because they will continuously spawn in hostile creatures.
• If kept intact, these can provide a useful and infinite source of resources that the hostile creatures may drop.
• The ratio of ranged and melee draugr is different from the default ratio (75% melee and 25% ranged).

Categorias: Building, Creature spawner
